description: Display ad quoting a simple rate under the floor and a loan amount over the maximum.
content: Consolidate and save! ClearPath personal loans from just 4.5% interest. Borrow up to $100,000. Apply today.
notes: 4.5% is below the 8.99% APR floor and $100,000 exceeds the $50,000 maximum (REGZ-24-AVAIL). The rate is a simple 'interest' rate with no APR (REGZ-24-APR). A UDAAP-APR flag would be defensible but is overlapping, so it is not required.
